note: Gated RV park on the Redwood Acres fairgrounds in east Eureka, RVs only (no tents). Rigs must be self-contained and in good condition and pass an entry inspection, and event nights at the fairgrounds can bring noise. --Claude
summary: Fairground RV page, the linked RV policy PDF, OSM, imagery and Google read. Ordinary nights are sold outside events: a standing '$45 per night' daily rate, booked by calling the camp host, for 'spring getaways, summer vacations, fall breaks, or winter hideaways'; the policy says only that it 'may not be available' during some events. Max 30 consecutive nights (14 per space). Member nights $38-40 (Good Sam, military, AAA, Escapees). 52 full-hookup 30/50 A sites. Not waterfront; pin fine. Phone 707-499-6187 confirmed.
flags: FAIRGROUND TEST: passes. The operator posts a 'Standard night rate: $45' open to anyone, for 'spring getaways, summer vacations, fall breaks, or winter hideaways', booked by phone with the camp host. The policy caveat is that the park 'may not be available at different times of the year depending on the events scheduled on the fairgrounds' (written into the season note). Imagery 2025-09-16 shows RVs in the west rows with no event on the grounds.
LONG-STAY: a monthly $745 rate exists (2021 policy), but the 30-consecutive-night cap ('You may return ... after 7 nights') rules out residents. Passes.
GOOGLE: no RV-park rating found. The panel is the fairgrounds' own; local ownership, so not gating.

HOOKUPS: sewer is from the current page ('52 full hook-up sites with water, sewer, power'). The 2021 policy lists only 'electrical ... water hookups, and dump station' and '30 & 50 amp ... depending upon the RV space location', so sewer at every site is uncertain. Kept per the current page.
PHONE: 707-499-6187 (RV camp host) kept; the fairground office is 707-445-3037.
WEBSITE: https://redwoodacres.com/rv-park/ redirects to https://www.redwoodacres.com/rv-park.html - suggest updating to the final URL.
PIN: stored 40.78001,-124.12892 is ~50 m from the OSM caravan_site node (40.77972,-124.12934) and beside the RV rows on the west side - fine.
SITES: count 52 is now operator-sourced. No rig limit posted ('Big Rig ... friendly'), so a 23-ft rig fits.
